To add **Long note** to Writer’s Files:

1. In **Notes**, find **Long note** and choose **Copy Ref ID**.
2. Open **Characters → Writer → Character settings → Files → New file**.
3. Choose **Note reference**, enter the copied Ref ID, and save.

I can’t add Files references through my maintenance tools: this workflow validates that the item exists and matches the reference kind, and captures its current name. Nothing has been changed.

The reference applies only to **Writer**. A chat copies the note on first use, using compressed text when available; text over the 256 KiB limit is omitted. An existing chat keeps its copy—later edits require a new session or adding the note again in the chat.
